assumptions.basis: The host is AVAILABLE_RESTORE on the required existing Vermilion map and matches the research role.
Preserves the prior progression boundary while reserving premium final forms for post-Hall-of-Fame high difficulty access.
No packet source defines within-tier rarity and equal weights are reproducible and auditable.
Avoids level-cap evolution dead ends and makes each paid encounter immediately usable.
Prevents arbitrage and satisfies repeatable typed-credit supply without replacing the direct BP path.
All selected species are outside the forbidden raid or special-capture owner set and the task permits only standard caught-state updates.
After the atomic pending commit no retry or completion path charges or refunds; the existing payload is sufficient.
The task preserves normal acquisition routes and this submission owns only reward encounter data.
